findings.source_quality: A: official Khronos dated event and source specification

findings.source_quality: A: merged Three.js PR and tests
findings.evidence: Merged correction of ColorManagement matrix multiplication for Display P3 vs sRGB cross-primaries conversions; author reproduced incorrect WebGL/WebGPU pixel results. Current KONA and Studio-Kona renderers explicitly use sRGB.
findings.contradiction: No current production improvement demonstrated; bug does not affect same-primaries sRGB path.
findings.implication: Add CPU/GPU sRGB-to-P3 color regression tests to EXP-THREE-R187-001; defer renderer upgrade.

findings.source_quality: A: merged PR, B: author benchmark
findings.evidence: Author reports material/node CPU build-time reductions of 28-34%, distinct from Oct 12 layout-dedup work. No active Three.js WebGPU/TSL path established in scanned portfolio main branches.
findings.contradiction: No evidence of FPS improvement or project-specific cold-load gain.
findings.implication: Extend existing Three.js experiment with graph build/cold frame/GPU pipeline compile separation and correctness tests.
